gates.title: Local passive replay and source-bound evidence
gates.owner: Software lead; controller accepts software scope
gates.method: Run tests/system on real Hub, replay and v1 model components using synthetic WAVs, source hashes and isolated temporary workspaces; check duplicates, provenance, forbidden output claims, restart and user-file preservation.
gates.criterion: Every listed system test passes for the hashed source configuration; no skipped tests. This is local software evidence only.
gates.status: Nine independent synthetic real-component system/contract scenarios passed on 2026-09-08; source-bound report accompanies this policy. Prior local acceptance remains in docs/validation/development-tranche-002.md.
gates.missing: Controller review of this bounded software evidence; broader hardware-output and release qualification remain separate.

gates.title: Declared product and funded release scope
gates.method: Review intended use, first variant, claims, flora branch decision, support capacity and funding authorization against the passive-first ADR.
gates.criterion: Named owner approves a revisioned scope and budget; flora remains separate and no prevention claim follows detector output.
gates.status: Staged EU/EEA scope agreed; variant, budget and commercial authorization open.
gates.missing: Signed scope/configuration freeze and spending/release decisions.

gates.title: Site access and operating envelope
gates.owner: Farm/site partner, marine engineer, ecologist and competent authorities
gates.method: Confirm site/concession and species; measure survey inputs; match each planned activity and coordinates to current written decisions and conditions; verify access, installation, recording and acoustic permission separately.
gates.criterion: No applicable permission unknown, pending, expired or denied; owner freezes the site envelope before field work.
gates.status: Region only: Limski zaljev/Istria; no exact site or permission accepted.
gates.missing: Site survey, access rights, authority decisions and approved numeric/categorical envelope.

gates.title: Local detection, labels and synchronization
gates.owner: Acquisition/data lead, ecologist and statistics reviewer
gates.method: Lock acquisition-owned protocol and recording/day/site partitions before holdout scoring; audit observed feeding labels and hard negatives; measure timing, precision/recall/false alerts, coverage, uncertainty and missing/clipped inputs.
gates.criterion: Qualified owners preregister thresholds and sample sizes; local held-out data meets them with stated uncertainty. Roadmap example metrics are not thresholds.
gates.status: No permitted local dataset or accepted detection/timing result.
gates.missing: Acquisition-owned frozen criteria, actual local recordings, calibration/timing evidence and independent study review.

gates.title: Collection and data handling
gates.owner: Data controller and Croatian/EU privacy adviser
gates.method: Assess personal/sensitive data, lawful basis, necessity, field of view, recipients, DPIA need and transfers; approve retention/access; execute deletion and restore/retention checks on the chosen deployment.
gates.criterion: Approved handling rules and controller roles precede collection/sharing; deletion behavior has measured software evidence.
gates.status: Synthetic local fixtures only; field data rules unresolved.
gates.missing: Controller decisions, privacy assessment and deployed retention/deletion test.

gates.title: Reproducibility and acquisition fault handling
gates.owner: Software, acquisition and firmware leads; controller owns full checks
gates.method: Controller runs clean-checkout pinned builds and full suites; verify selected ARM64 and ESP targets, live input drop/overflow/clock counters, resource bounds and paired evidence failures.
gates.criterion: Frozen target/fault matrix passes on chosen devices; local host tests cannot stand in for ARM64, ESP or HIL.
gates.status: Prior local monitor checks accepted; target hardware and full new integration not accepted.
gates.missing: Root full-check results for this wave; selected-target reproducibility, acquisition and HIL evidence.

gates.title: Independent stop and calibrated acoustic safety
gates.owner: Safety owner, electrical and underwater-acoustics specialists, ecologist
gates.method: Review HAZ-001/002/003/005/013/014/015; approved dummy-load faults and physical stop tests precede authorized calibrated water tests; measure pressure/exposure with reference units, geometry and uncertainty, particle motion where needed.
gates.criterion: Specialist-approved envelope and fault/abort bounds pass; independent inhibit defeats host failure and recovery never rearms. Digital RMS/peak is not SPL.
gates.status: No output authorized; no physical stop or acoustic calibration evidence.
gates.missing: Signed method/envelope, physical safety design verification, facility authorization and calibrated measured reports.

gates.title: Surface communications and offline recovery
gates.method: Inspect wired wet/surface RF architecture; freeze link, airtime, load and retention assumptions; fault-test bounded buffering, deduplication, expiry and reconnect; measure actual gateway coverage and offered-load denominator.
gates.criterion: Measured field link and offline behavior meet approved criteria; old 95%/five-minute goal is not accepted without denominator and scope.
gates.status: No accepted site radio survey or deployed network-server/gateway evidence.
gates.missing: Frozen topology, spectrum settings, field survey, real-network and outage results.

gates.title: Marine envelope and endurance
gates.owner: Marine/mechanical engineer and competent test facility
gates.method: Trace selected housings/seals/materials and revisions to vendor sources; independent calculations and approved guarded facility pressure/leak/load/corrosion/thermal/endurance methods; serial-linked raw measurements and post-test inspection.
gates.criterion: Declared depth/time/load/service envelope passes competent tests. CAD, IP labels and vendor depth claims cannot pass final assemblies.
gates.status: Provisional reference engineering only; no assembled tested unit.
gates.missing: Frozen hardware interface/envelope, purchased-unit traceability, facility reports and integrated endurance results.

gates.title: Electrical, thermal and solar reserve
gates.method: Freeze hardware-owned load states and site solar inputs; measure peak/inrush/drop/brownout/thermal behavior and battery autonomy; reconcile losses and protection to component source data.
gates.criterion: Measured worst-case power and thermal limits meet the reviewed envelope; bench supply or spreadsheet is not field autonomy.
gates.status: No accepted measured power budget or seasonal reserve evidence.
gates.missing: Numeric limits, selected power chain, calibrated instruments and bench/field results.

gates.title: Signed lifecycle and recoverable update
gates.owner: Security owner with platform and firmware leads
gates.method: Test unsigned/wrong-target/rollback-floor rejection, privilege/scope/expiry/replay checks, every update interruption stage, restore and key rotation/revocation; independently review signer, boot chain and release process.
gates.criterion: All approved cases reach known-good or tested service recovery; no unexplained brick or automatic rearm; secret custody and support obligations funded.
gates.status: Local authentication evidence exists; final device/boot/update trust chain not accepted.
gates.missing: Chosen target secure boot/update evidence, hardware power-cut matrix and independent security assessment.

gates.title: Conditional deterrence claim
gates.owner: Marine ecologist, statistics reviewer and farm partner
gates.method: Acquisition-owned preregistered controlled study with independent loss/feeding outcomes, sham/no-output, repeat-exposure/habituation and non-target monitoring; contextualize failed 2019 Lim Bay DDD03L trial.
gates.criterion: Authorized trial meets preregistered safety and sustained effect criteria; failed/harmful/inconclusive results block deterrence, not passive monitoring.
gates.status: Negative prior pinger evidence; no Poseidon trial or effect accepted.
gates.missing: Prior raw methods, approved study, calibrated exposures, observed outcomes and independent gate decision.

gates.title: EU/EEA and Croatian applicable duties
gates.owner: Qualified compliance adviser, test lab and legal manufacturer
gates.method: Dated intended-use/variant applicability assessment, current standards and conformity route; final-system tests, technical file, instructions, labels and manufacturer declaration with authority/notified-body involvement where required.
gates.criterion: Applicable duties closed for exact released configuration and placing-on-market date. Source research is not certification; module CE does not establish final conformity.
gates.status: Desk source review in this wave; no final configuration assessment or declaration.
gates.missing: Professional applicability decision, final-system reports, approved labeling/DoC and market/operator duties.

gates.title: Repeatable pilot manufacture
gates.method: Freeze pilot quantity, yield/rework limits and travelers; independent second assembler builds from revisioned instructions; reconcile serial/lot/BOM/software/key-reference/calibration/EOL records, failures and actual cost.
gates.criterion: Every unit has genuine traceable passing EOL records and controlled nonconformance; approved pilot yield and cost criteria pass.
gates.status: Procedures/templates only; no manufactured batch or measured yield.
gates.missing: Funded PVT plan, real second-assembler records, serial-linked test data and approved release decision.

gates.title: Funded service, incidents and support
gates.owner: Product owner, service/security owners and legal adviser
gates.method: Approve and fund maintenance/retrieval/spares/warranty/vulnerability/recall/disposal/end-of-support processes; execute representative service, key-revocation, incident and recovery drills.
gates.criterion: Named accountable people, funded support period and measured drills support declared obligations before commercial authorization.
gates.status: No approved lifetime budget or exercised service organization.
gates.missing: Budget/terms, competent service arrangements, spare lead times, drills and final commercial authorization.
